Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

Assisted-by: OpenAI Codex

## Motivation

Parallel sampling gives its common-prefix seed and children distinct request IDs but the same bootstrap room in the [Python tokenizer path](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/6cac4dc3fe9a4bf15009f300132c3c7a1853c210/python/sglang/srt/managers/tokenizer_manager.py#L2136-L2195). NIXL indexes in-flight transfer state by room, so the collision can fail transfer. [PR #43863](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43863) fixes the Rust frontend, not this path; related [#26486](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/26486) and [#24223](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/24223) closed without merging.

## Modifications

Give the seed and each child a deterministic, distinct 63-bit room while preserving its data-parallel routing. Single-sample requests stay unchanged; explicit per-child rooms remain supported. No user-facing documentation changes are needed.

## Accuracy Tests

- Historical NIXL P/D requests with 2–4 samples hit a transfer-worker assertion before the fix; `2/2` matched fixed runs completed.
- On main `2e7c9d851c`, the tokenizer-manager suite passed `52/52` with a `datasets` stub. A current-main NIXL P/D serving replay on the fix branch completed public requests with 2, 3, and 4 samples (all HTTP 200); the router, prefill, and decode workers and the post-run probe stayed healthy. The prefill log did emit one nonfatal NIXL descriptor-shape error, so this is a limited smoke test. It used Triton/eager execution because the local `sglang-kernel` 0.4.5 is incompatible with main's FA3 CUDA-graph path; it is not a matched FA3 performance result.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

RTX A6000, NIXL P/D, dummy Llama-4, Triton/eager: two warmed 30-request rounds at concurrency 3. Single-sample control throughput was 359–381 vs. 365–369 output tok/s (baseline vs. fix). With 2–4 samples, baseline failed all six warmups; the fix completed 60/60 measured requests at 388–396 tok/s. A speed ratio is therefore not meaningful; FA3/CUDA graphs were not benchmarked.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -211,6 +211,39 @@
 
 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
+_MAX_BOOTSTRAP_ROOM = (1 << 63) - 1
+
+
+def _distinct_parallel_bootstrap_rooms(
+    rooms: List[Optional[int]], batch_size: int, sample_count: int, dp_size: int
+) -> Tuple[List[Optional[int]], List[Optional[int]]]:
+    """Preserve normalized child rooms while giving the prefix seeds new rooms."""
+
+    if len(rooms) != batch_size * sample_count:
+        raise ValueError("parallel bootstrap room count does not match sample count")
+    step = max(dp_size, 1)
+    used: set[int] = set()
+
+    def reserve(room: Optional[int]) -> Optional[int]:
+        if room is None:
+            return None
+        room = int(room)
+        if room < 0 or room > _MAX_BOOTSTRAP_ROOM:
+            raise ValueError("bootstrap room must fit in a signed 63-bit integer")
+        residue = room % step
+        capacity = (_MAX_BOOTSTRAP_ROOM - residue) // step + 1
+        position = (room - residue) // step
+        for offset in range(len(used) + 1):
+            candidate = residue + ((position + offset) % capacity) * step
+            if candidate not in used:
+                used.add(candidate)
+                return candidate
+        raise ValueError("no unused bootstrap room remains for this DP rank")
+
+    child_rooms = [reserve(room) for room in rooms]
+    seed_rooms = [reserve(rooms[i]) for i in range(batch_size)]
+    return seed_rooms, child_rooms
+
